text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew. It really is hot, isn't it...?
choice_data_list: You're not good with the heat, right?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But... it's also a chance to build 
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I can just build up my stamina, I'm 
sure... I could do even more...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back, please give it your all. 
Trainer...!

—The final summer training camp with 
Silence Suzuka has begun!
